posts.zh:
dsh-deepseek-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-05f9bbdeadac4c5f1b89.html
posts.en:
dsh-deepseek-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-05f9bbdeadac4c5f1b89.html
